name: agent-deck
description: 本机桌面端：统一管理 Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity 的原生会话，并附带 SSH 服务器控制台

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.json && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run docs:check && npm run dup && npm run build:desktop && npm run coverage
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @agentdeck/server" "npm run dev -w @agentdeck/web"
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build -w @agentdeck/web && npm run dev -w @agentdeck/desktop
scripts.start: npm run build -w @agentdeck/web && npm run start -w @agentdeck/server
